⅓ cup Parmesan cheese (freshly grated is best)

steps.title: Prepare the squash
steps.body: Cut the squash in half and slice a piece off the pointy end so it can sit flat on the pan. Remove seeds and stem, brush with **3 Tbsp olive oil**, and sprinkle salt and pepper over the insides of the squash.

steps.title: Roast the squash
steps.body: Put in the oven for 30 minutes or until the squash is tender.

steps.title: Cook the sausage
steps.body: Cook **1 lb Italian sausage** on the stove, then set aside.

steps.title: Cook the vegetables
steps.body: Cook **1 small yellow onion** and **3 ribs celery** in the sausage drippings, and once they are soft, add **1 apple**, peeled, cored, and diced, **4 cloves garlic**, **2 tsp thyme**, salt, pepper and **½ tsp red pepper flakes**.

steps.title: Sauté the stuffing
steps.body: Sauté for 4 minutes and then add the sausage back to the mixture.

steps.title: Fill the squash
steps.body: Cook for 3 more minutes and then spoon into the hollows of the cooked acorn squash.

steps.title: Make the topping
steps.body: Combine **⅓ cup Parmesan cheese** and **⅓ cup bread crumbs** and sprinkle over the stuffed squash.

steps.title: Crisp the topping
steps.body: Place in the oven for 15 minutes, or until the Parmesan topping is just starting to crisp.
